quality_highlights.aspect: Exemplary multi-repo example: mermaid diagram, permission table, security tip for GitHub App tokens, and Related Documentation section with clear cross-links
Status messages are clean and consistent: single emoji, workflow link, and plain-English description — professional without being verbose

single_file_improvements.issue: Opening paragraph uses theatrical/carnival-barker tone ('Step right up, step right up, and enter the documentation chamber') that clashes with the data-driven, professional content that follows. Creates an inconsistent voice in public-facing enterprise documentation.

run-success message contains 'This is a developing story.' which semantically contradicts the success state ('concluded', 'All systems operational'). The 🎤 emoji is also contextually misplaced for a resolved/success signal.
